item.title: Extremal Combinatorics Outreach Tour
item.description:
The Extremal Combinatorics Outreach Tour is a travelling initiative to promote the field in Brazilian regions without established research groups, planned to begin in 2027.

The Project

The tour aims to visit 3 states per year without researchers working in extremal combinatorics. On each visit, our team delivers a four- to five-day introductory mini-course focusing on the foundations and central problems of the field.

To provide participants with teaching and support, each visit will involve:

item.title: Learning Resources
item.description:
Below are learning resources produced by community members, along with links to courses and talks.

Books

  • Basic Graph Theory (Purchase)
    B. Bollobás, R. Morris, 2026
    Cambridge University Press.

    This book offers an accessible, modern introduction to graph theory, from classical foundations such as matchings and colouring to active research areas including extremal and random graphs. With its focus on elegant proofs and essential techniques, it is ideal for students entering the field.
